scripts.build:release: npm run build --workspace=frontend && xcopy /E /Y /I frontend\dist dist\frontend\dist && pkg backend/src/index.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/backend.exe && npm run dist
scripts.db:init: node -e "require('dotenv').config({path:'backend/.env'}); const {Pool}=require('pg'); const fs=require('fs'); const pool=new Pool({host:process.env.DB_HOST,port:process.env.DB_PORT,database:process.env.DB_NAME,user:'postgres',password:'294657'}); pool.query(fs.readFileSync('database/schema.sql','utf8')).then(()=>{console.log('Schema applied');pool.end()}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);pool.end()});"
